script_text: Pisces, a hidden truth surfaces this week and your intuition will lead everything dramatically. Thursday, Venus sextiles Jupiter, your traditional ruler, unlocking love and money through your 2nd and 5th Houses suddenly. Friday onward, the Moon in your 4th House calms fog and heals home and family bonds. Saturday, Mars trines your 11th House, bringing networking wins and passionate unexpected weekend social invitations. Best day: Thursday, when Venus sextiles Jupiter, boosting love and money greatly. Worst day: Tuesday, Mercury squares your 7th House, sparking conflict. Advice: protect sleep, trust intuition, and avoid major spending until Sunday. Follow for daily updates.
